reference: GNU coreutils head from the runner's read-only /usr tree is the independent oracle, run by system Bash with the same bounded fixture script under LC_ALL=C; bash-os runs it with PATH empty. The runner compares status, stdout, stderr where a case asks for it, and the private fixture tree.

cases.purpose: G90: GNU head's "cannot open 'F' for reading" and "error reading 'F'" ('standard input' for -) with getopt's unrecognized-option line and Try line.
cases.script:
mkdir d
printf 'a\n' > f
{ head nosuch f || echo rc=$?; } 2>err
{ head d || echo rc=$?; } 2>>err
{ head < d || echo rc=$?; } 2>>err
{ head --bogus || echo rc=$?; } 2>>err
sed 's/^fixture: line [0-9]*: //' err >&2
rm err

cases.purpose: G90: GNU head always quotes the file name (a'b, a b), keeps going after a failed operand with the ==> headers, and uses getopt's lines for an unknown short option and a missing -n argument.
cases.script:
mkdir d
printf 'a\n' > f
{ head "a'b" 'a b' || echo rc=$?; } 2>err
{ head d f || echo rc=$?; } 2>>err
{ head -x || echo rc=$?; } 2>>err
{ head -n || echo rc=$?; } 2>>err
sed 's/^fixture: line [0-9]*: //' err >&2
rm err
